name: tutti
title: Tutti
description: Control Tutti — play the same audio through many output devices at once — from the Raycast launcher.
author: Barrybarrywu

commands.name: apply-preset
commands.title: Apply Preset
commands.description: Switch Tutti to one of your saved presets.

commands.name: toggle-mute
commands.title: Toggle Mute
commands.description: Mute or unmute Tutti's whole output.

commands.name: set-volume
commands.title: Set Volume
commands.description: Set Tutti's output volume to a specific percentage.

commands.name: volume-up
commands.title: Increase Volume
commands.description: Raise Tutti's output volume by a fixed step.

commands.name: volume-down
commands.title: Decrease Volume
commands.description: Lower Tutti's output volume by a fixed step.
